what: Mistake: set hard numeric targets for cut B (full suite under 6, then 7 minutes) without knowing they were reachable; three attempts (eebk, xgk9, y179, about $9 and 4 hours) each cut Athena's test check from about 12 to 7.4 to 7.8 minutes and were each rejected for missing the number, so none landed.
why: A speed request should ask for a measured improvement against a measured baseline, or set a target only after a measurement shows it is reachable; the rabbit-hole guard (20261025-034247-nm0k) should flag a line of work rejected twice for the same unmet target.
